wholePrompts.wholeText: Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve the referenced amino-acid image completely EXCEPT hydration decoration. Both neutral zwitterionic structures, labels 'pH7', 'Alanin', 'Serin', 'NH₃⁺', 'COO⁻', centre C,H,CH₃,CH₂OH, bonds, layout, colour and dimensions remain unchanged. REMOVE ALL the atom-labelled water molecules and all dotted lines around them; they incorrectly imply hydration orientations. Replace those decorations with a few SIMPLE LIGHT-BLUE WATER-DROPLET ICONS without any letters, atom circles, dipole arrows or bonds. Show water-droplet icons near the charged amino and carboxylate groups of BOTH amino acids, and near the serine side-chain OH. No crossed water droplet and no insolubility claim for alanine. Opaque PNG, same wide format; add no new text.

Use case: scientific-educational. Opaque PNG for upper-secondary chemistry, landscape near16:9, about1600x900. Friendly abstract comic with warm cream background, colored outlines and large clear main motifs legible at360px width. No photorealism, technical IDs, dense paragraphs or tiny labels. Correct chemistry is mandatory. Compare side chains of FREE amino acids while retaining their shared ionic groups. Two large schematic amino-acid connectivity diagrams at pH7. Both have centre 'C' bonded to H above, 'NH₃⁺' to left, 'COO⁻' to right; below left a highlighted orange 'CH₃' group, below right blue 'CH₂OH'. Labels 'Alanin' left and 'Serin' right; each molecule surrounded by a few pale water droplets visibly able to approach the shared charged groups. One large label at top 'pH 7'. Side chains affect interactions, but do NOT draw water crossed out, oil-only affinity, insoluble alanine or whole-molecule hydrophobicity. No Fischer-stereochemistry claims; connectivity only. Large correct superscripts, exactly four bonds at alpha carbon.

Use case: scientific-educational. Opaque PNG for upper-secondary chemistry, landscape near16:9, about1600x900. Friendly abstract comic with warm cream background, colored outlines and large clear main motifs legible at360px width. No photorealism, technical IDs, dense paragraphs or tiny labels. Correct chemistry is mandatory. Two simple chemically correct amino-acid naming cards. Left large formula 'NH₂–CH₂–COOH', with the carbon letter C in CH₂ highlighted ORANGE and the carbon letter C in COOH highlighted BLUE; directly UNDER those two highlighted carbon letters place large labels 'C2' and 'C1' respectively, with very short arrows pointing EXACTLY to the relevant carbon letters, never N or O. Label 'Glycin'. Right large formula 'CH₃–CH(NH₂)–COOH' with a conventional branch: NH₂ is beneath central CH linked by one short vertical single bond. Highlight central CH carbon orange, carboxyl COOH carbon blue; labels/arrows 'C2' to central C and 'C1' to carboxyl C. Label 'Alanin'. Bottom phrase 'Amino an C2'. No extra carbonyl carbon after COOH, no name text too long, no stereo wedges. Correct constitution and numbering must remain obvious at360px.
